title: Potion of Mind Reading

sources.title: Potions
markers: Other potions simply have no effect

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to read certain creatures’ thoughts in dialogue until the next Long Rest.

fields.Activation: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle to gain Detect Thoughts until the next Long Rest.
fields.Scope: Applies in eligible dialogue. Throwing the potion does not apply the effect.
fields.Crafting: Combine Suspension of Mergrass with any Sublimate.
fields.Creative use: Drink before a conversation where additional information could change your approach.
fields.Base value: 20 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added source-reviewed native BG3 gameplay, consumption, and crafting details.
